resources.string: Android has not linked this watch to OpenWatch. Without the link, OpenWatch cannot record workouts that another app starts on the watch.
OpenWatch needs the Nearby devices permission to reach the watch.
The watch is not paired with this phone. Open Bluetooth settings and pair it; make the watch discoverable from its own Bluetooth settings first.

The OpenWatch app on the watch records your heart rate and what a sleep estimate needs, and keeps a week of it. Sync copies the new heart rate into Health Connect and writes one estimated sleep session per night.

resources.string: The watch keeps these settings itself. Read them to change them here.
The watch did not answer. Is it near and its OpenWatch app running?
About every 10 minutes outside bedtime mode. Bedtime mode always measures every 10 seconds.
Keeps every sleep minute with the heart rate sensor\'s wake-ups instead of a lasting wake lock. Works only with the heart rate from the sensor.
Samsung platform: needs Health Platform Developer Mode on the watch. Without it the platform asks Samsung about this app. A Samsung source that fails falls back to the sensor.
Heart rate from the Samsung platform
Allow it on the watch: open OpenWatch there and switch it on once.
Off: the watch\'s own sensor, live. On: the platform\'s value, handed over in batches up to 10 minutes late with the screen off. A workout uses the sensor either way.
Off: HRV from the raw pulse signal, every interval. On: the platform\'s beat intervals; today about 60 % of them get lost, so fewer nights have a value.
Skin temperature at the wrist while you sleep, a reading a minute. Little power; nothing else changes.
Blood oxygen at most once an hour while you sleep, about 15 s of red light. A few mAh a night; skipped when the arm moves.
